svg.title: A system call, step by step
svg.desc: The app in user mode runs mov x16, #20 then svc #0x80. The hardware switches to kernel mode, masks interrupts, saves the return address 0x1008 (the instruction after the svc) and the reason "svc #0x80", and jumps to the vector table slot at base 0x8000 plus 0x400. The kernel reads the reason (an svc), reads the request in x16 (20, getpid), puts the answer 42 in x0 and runs eret, which restores user mode and jumps to the saved address 0x1008. A page fault differs in one way: the saved address is the faulting instruction itself, so it runs again.

g.text: Page fault: the saved address is the faulting instruction, so it runs again.
